Verifies that the navigator.onLine override survives cross-document navigations.
navigator.onLine: false
navigator.onLine after same-origin navigation: false
navigator.onLine after cross-origin navigation: false
navigator.onLine after clearing the override: true
navigator.onLine after navigating without the override: true
